name: PantryPulse
description: A grocery and pantry management app to track items, expiry dates and prices, discover ingredient-based recipes, and review food-waste analytics.
features: Food-waste analytics and estimated value at risk
Ingredient aliases such as dahi and yogurt
Email alerts where supported by the application

name: DocuMind
description: A multi-PDF question-answering app that retrieves relevant passages and provides answers with source filenames and page references.
features: Extractive fallback without an API key
Scanned PDFs requiring OCR are not supported
